qualification_routes.title: Generated data → useful target policy
qualification_routes.established: A data-generation and action-labeling method can improve selected research task scores.
qualification_routes.decision_gap: Unique eligible data, inherited grounding, full compute/manual work, target acceptance and physical validation must be measured.
qualification_routes.gate_to_test: Freeze the same target tasks and held-out physical criteria; charge failed generation, processing, training and validation before comparing alternatives.

qualification_routes.title: New embodiment → retained qualified capability
qualification_routes.established: Controlled video tests isolate appearance, motion representation and target-only adaptation effects.
qualification_routes.decision_gap: A video metric or target-only gain does not establish control-policy performance or preservation of installed-cohort capability.
qualification_routes.gate_to_test: Keep unseen target and retained-source configurations separate; require physical acceptance and regression checks before rolling out a shared update.

qualification_routes.title: Working integration → supported usable capacity
qualification_routes.established: A configured reference workflow and self-assessment framework identify concrete integration work and required records.
qualification_routes.decision_gap: Independent sim/real paths, technical self-scores and a newer model name do not establish transfer, available parts or supported customer service.
qualification_routes.gate_to_test: Bind hardware, policy, interface, runtime and site versions to actual acceptance, capacity/parts commitments, rights and support obligations.

stages: Define target service and old/new configuration identities
Deduplicate eligible data and preserve use rights
Fund generation, action labeling, curation and training
Measure held-out target service and retained-cohort regression
Qualify runtime, calibration, integration and recovery
Verify actual supported supply, parts, rights and customer cash obligations

next_counterfactuals.name: No learning
next_counterfactuals.intervention: Eligible operating data and R&D expenditure may accumulate, but no candidate capability improvement is granted.
next_counterfactuals.required_conservation: Keep collection/training/validation costs and unchanged physical service; no data-value premium.

next_counterfactuals.name: No transfer
next_counterfactuals.intervention: A candidate qualifies only for its explicitly validated embodiment/task/site; prior cohorts retain their old configuration.
next_counterfactuals.required_conservation: Do not relabel installed assets or duplicate data benefits; charge separate adaptation and validation.

next_counterfactuals.name: Support before expansion
next_counterfactuals.intervention: A shared engineering/physical-validation resource must maintain installed supported service before admitting a new candidate/start.
next_counterfactuals.required_conservation: One finite calendar/resource allocation; missed service and committed staffing persist.

next_counterfactuals.name: Qualified supply delay
next_counterfactuals.intervention: An ordered/financed unit or part arrives after its required qualification/service date.
next_counterfactuals.required_conservation: Preserve payment, physical identity, WIP/readiness and lost due output; do not count orders as operational units.

three_pack_application.hospital: Candidate control/dispatch changes must preserve urgency, identity, custody and retained fallback.
three_pack_application.utility: New sensing/vision must preserve point identity, accepted quality/review and residual physical duties.
three_pack_application.automotive: A new policy or hardware generation must meet the same unique-kit timing and quality, including buffer/transport and support boundaries.
